data.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_donation_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.donation_status is distinct from old.donation_status and not (
    (old.donation_status='SUBMITTED' and new.donation_status='AVAILABLE'
      and new.collection_path='DIRECT_PICKUP' and new.total_weight_kg>=10)
    or (old.donation_status='SUBMITTED' and new.donation_status='HUB_ASSIGNED'
      and new.collection_path='HUB_COLLECTION' and new.total_weight_kg>0 and new.total_weight_kg<10)
    or (old.donation_status in ('SUBMITTED','AVAILABLE','HUB_ASSIGNED') and new.donation_status='CANCELLED')
    or (old.donation_status='AVAILABLE' and new.donation_status='CLAIMED' and new.collection_path='DIRECT_PICKUP')
    or (old.donation_status='HUB_ASSIGNED' and new.donation_status='AT_HUB')
    or (old.donation_status='AT_HUB' and new.donation_status='BATCHED')
    or (old.donation_status='BATCHED' and new.donation_status='CLAIMED' and new.collection_path='HUB_COLLECTION')
    or (old.donation_status='CLAIMED' and new.donation_status='PICKUP_IN_PROGRESS')
    or (old.donation_status='CLAIMED' and new.donation_status='AVAILABLE' and new.collection_path='DIRECT_PICKUP')
    or (old.donation_status='CLAIMED' and new.donation_status='BATCHED' and new.collection_path='HUB_COLLECTION')
    or (old.donation_status='PICKUP_IN_PROGRESS' and new.donation_status='COLLECTED')
  ) then
    raise exception 'INVALID_DONATION_TRANSITION: % -> %',old.donation_status,new.donation_status;
  end if;
  new.updated_at=clock_timestamp();
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geolock_assign_vehicle_depot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  select n.road_node_id into new.depot_road_node_id
    from public.ngo_profiles n
   where n.user_id = new.ngo_user_id and n.location_verified_at is not null;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.geolock_road_costs(p_sources bigint[], p_targets bigint[], p_center_lat double precision, p_center_lon double precision, p_radius_m double precision)
 RETURNS TABLE(source_node bigint, target_node bigint, road_km double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_snapshot text := public.geolock_active_road_snapshot(); v_sql text;
begin
  if v_snapshot is null or coalesce(cardinality(p_sources), 0) = 0
     or coalesce(cardinality(p_targets), 0) = 0 then
    return;
  end if;
  v_sql := format(
    'select e.edge_id as id, e.source_node as source, e.target_node as target,
            e.road_km::float8 as cost, -1::float8 as reverse_cost
       from public.road_network_nodes n
       join public.road_network_edges e on e.source_node = n.osm_node_id
      where n.network_snapshot_id = %L and n.active_flag
        and extensions.ST_DWithin(n.geog,
              extensions.ST_SetSRID(extensions.ST_MakePoint(%L::float8, %L::float8), 4326)::extensions.geography,
              %L::float8)',
    v_snapshot, p_center_lon, p_center_lat, p_radius_m);
  return query
    select s, s, 0::float8
      from unnest(p_sources) s where s = any(p_targets)
    union all
    select c.start_vid, c.end_vid, c.agg_cost
      from extensions.pgr_dijkstraCost(v_sql, p_sources, p_targets, true) c;
  -- road_km is stored as real (float4); sums are exact to well under 1 m.
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_audit_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'AUDIT_APPEND_ONLY'; end $function$

security.query: SELECT c.relname,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,r.rolname,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,c.oid,'SELECT') AS can_select,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,c.oid,'INSERT') AS can_insert,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,c.oid,'UPDATE') AS can_update,has_table_privilege(r.rolname,c.oid,'DELETE') AS can_delete FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN pg_roles r WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('vehicles','pickup_tasks','pickup_routes','pickup_route_stops','active_task_route_assignments','donations','listings','claim_leases','donation_claims','road_network_edges') AND r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role') ORDER BY c.relname,r.rolname;

policies.query: SELECT tablename,policyname,roles,cmd,qual,with_check FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('vehicles','pickup_tasks','pickup_routes','pickup_route_stops','active_task_route_assignments','donations','listings','claim_leases','donation_claims','road_network_edges');

schema_roles.query: SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolcanlogin,has_schema_privilege(rolname,'public','CREATE') AS public_create FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres');

defaults.query: SELECT pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS owner,n.nspname,d.defaclobjtype,d.defaclacl::text FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' OR d.defaclnamespace=0;

triggers.query: SELECT c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) AS definition FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname IN ('vehicles','pickup_tasks','pickup_routes','pickup_route_stops','active_task_route_assignments','donations','listings') ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname;

inventory.query: SELECT 'table' AS kind,c.relname AS name FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind='r' UNION ALL SELECT 'function',p.oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.prokind='f' ORDER BY kind,name;
